discovery.description: Compare the latest official monthly weighted-average interest rates for two Treasury security categories using the same Fiscal Data record date. Returns left_higher, right_higher, within_tolerance, or human_review. spreadBps is left minus right in basis points. This is not a live market yield spread, yield-curve trading signal, forecast, or investment recommendation.
discovery.resource_description: Compare the latest official monthly weighted-average interest rates for two U.S. Treasury security categories from the same Fiscal Data record date. Returns left_higher, right_higher, within_tolerance, or human_review. This is not a live market yield spread, forecast, or investment recommendation.

buyer.task: Compare the latest official monthly weighted-average interest rates for two U.S. Treasury security categories from the same record date and classify their spread.

expected_purchase_frequency.measurement_plan: Measure only independent external settled buyers and repeat demand; never count test responses, discovery visits, or synthetic transactions as sales.

sources.authority: U.S. Treasury Fiscal Data monthly Average Interest Rates on U.S. Treasury Securities
sources.refresh_policy: Compare latest records for two distinct security categories on the same official record date

rules: Require distinct security descriptions and two valid Treasury rate observations for the same record date.
Compute left-minus-right spread in basis points and apply inclusive tolerance.
A monthly average spread is not a live yield spread or trading signal.
the source values are monthly weighted-average rates on outstanding Treasury securities
the spread is not a live market yield spread
the result is not a forecast, curve-trading signal, or investment recommendation

failure_behavior.required_source_failure: HTTP 502 with chargeable=false; payment is not settled.

criteria: Exact-head existing product release gates and deterministic/source checks must pass.
